title: betula lenta var. humilis
intro: Betula lenta var. humilis, commonly known as American dwarf birch, is a small shrub or tree species belonging to the Betulaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The health benefits of Betula lenta var. humilis include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of Betula lenta var. humilis include salicin, a compound similar to aspirin, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and astringent properties.
